scope: Reconcile ENABLE_ENTITIES payload size contradiction between bigworld-engine-advisor memory (8 bytes SGW) and W-misc-gaps Session 5 (1 byte).
verdict: 8 bytes — SGW-custom uint64 dummy. Binary is definitive. W-misc-gaps was wrong.

primary_binary.role: Size argument to InterfaceElement constructor for the enableEntities descriptor

calibration.conclusion: Same push position in identical constructor call pattern; PUSH 0x1 = 1 byte for resetEntities, PUSH 0x8 = 8 bytes for enableEntities

w_misc_gaps_error.what_they_reported: Address 0x017bae02 as 'MOV DWORD PTR [struct], 1'; concluded size = 1
w_misc_gaps_error.actual_instruction_at_017bae02: MOV [0x01ef2500], EAX  (stores descriptor pointer, not a size value)
w_misc_gaps_error.misidentified_instruction: 0x017badf7: MOV DWORD PTR [EAX], 0x1 writes a reliability flag into the stack-allocated arg struct — not the message size
w_misc_gaps_error.root_cause: W-misc-gaps retrieved only the cross-reference target instruction without the surrounding disassembly context; the size push (0x017bade9: PUSH 0x8) was three instructions earlier and not visible
